titolo: Ant Group launches LingSante-3.1-flash model on Hugging Face
descr: On 19 November 2026 Ant Group announced the release of LingSante-3.1-flash on Hugging Face.
paragrafi: On 19 November 2026 Ant Group announced the release of LingSante-3.1-flash on Hugging Face.
The model is listed under the repository inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-flash and is tagged for text-generation, conversational use, and safetensors format.
Since its publication, the model has been downloaded 397 times and received 111 likes from the community.
LingSante-3.1-flash is offered as a public, non‑gated model without inference providers, allowing anyone to download and run it locally.
perche: For users seeking free or locally runnable AI, LingSante-3.1-flash provides another open‑source conversational option with a modest download footprint.
